subject: Replace long long timestamp references with more specific mstime_t/ustime_t (#3252)
reason: The change only renames types: every edit replaces a `long long` declaration, cast or sizeof with `mstime_t` or `ustime_t`, both of which are `typedef long long` (src/util.h:71-72). Type sizes, alignment, signedness, arithmetic, the entry expiry memory layout and all format strings are unchanged, so no behaviour, reply, persistence or replication path differs from the parent build. A pure refactor with no observable effect needs no scenario.
